_說明: 小曲 模式二（純配樂商品帶貨片）設定檔範例＝2026-10-05 保溫杯示範案。複製一份改成你的案子，路徑相對於這個 json 所在資料夾。提示詞只寫想看到的東西，不寫「不要什麼」。 logo 填圖檔路徑才會在右上角加標誌；客戶片放客戶的標誌，你的公司自家片放 templates/你的公司標誌_白.png。
product_desc: five insulated bottles (cream white, sage green, sky blue, pastel pink, matte black) with rounded caps and a small oval push-button on the front of each cap

scenes.name: 1_通勤
scenes.prompt: A sky blue insulated bottle standing in the side pocket of a beige canvas tote bag carried on a shoulder, warm morning sunlight, background is a smooth creamy bokeh of soft golden lights and blurred commuters, lifestyle product photography, 9:16 vertical, natural warm tones, very shallow depth of field.

scenes.name: 3_五色平拍
scenes.prompt: All five bottles (cream white, sage green, sky blue, pastel pink, matte black) lying side by side diagonally on a soft pastel linen backdrop, top-down flat lay, even soft studio light, gentle shadows, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.name: 4_開蓋特寫
scenes.prompt: Keeping the exact same cap shape with the small oval button on the front of the cap. Close-up of a hand holding a pastel pink insulated bottle, the thumb resting on the oval button of the closed cap, bright clean soft white background, crisp focus on the cap and button, product macro photography, 9:16 vertical.

shots.name: 1_開場

shots.name: 3_通勤

shots.name: 5_收尾

music.prompt: Bright, fresh lifestyle product commercial music. Upbeat acoustic guitar strums, light ukulele, soft hand claps, glockenspiel sparkles, gentle bass, 112 BPM, cheerful morning-commute feeling. Short intro sparkle, clear groove from the start, warm resolved ending on the final bar.
